newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH KPW GRANTS MORE ADVISING, MANAGING LICENCES.
newsitem.headline: POLISH KPW GRANTS MORE ADVISING, MANAGING LICENCES.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) awarded Magnus brokerage, the brokerage of unit of Kredyt Bank SA and ING BSK Asset Management SA permission to provide advising services, the KPW's head said on Thursday.

Jacek Socha also told a news conference that Penetrator brokerage received approval to provide portfolio management services and Bank Slaski SA received approval to act as an intermediary for ING BSK Asset Management SA in providing portfolio management services.
"We're continually seeing brokerages providing higher quality services," Socha said. -- Steven Silber +48 22 653 9700
